subject: Initial vendor intake — privacy checklist & DPA determination
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@novuscloud.com>, Ben Stone <ben.stone@novuscloud.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial vendor intake — privacy checklist & DPA determination

Hi Olivia / Ben,

Thanks for the productive intro call earlier. I'm kicking off the procurement onboarding checklist so we can get NovusCloud set up for a PO and move toward production access. To keep things moving, can you please: 

1) Complete the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and return it.
2) Confirm whether NovusCloud processes any Redwood customer personal data or account identifiers as part of the service (yes/no + short description).
3) Provide a current subprocessor list (CSV is fine) and the contact for your data protection officer.
4) Confirm your standard data retention windows for logs, backups, and customer data.
5) Tell us whether you require a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or if you operate under your standard terms (we can execute a DPA via DocuSign if needed).
6) Provide a SOC 2 report or a pointer to an online report download.
7) For PO/billing: who should the PO be addressed to and which billing email should invoices be sent to?

If you can return items 1–4 in the next 3 business days that would keep our onboarding slot for May. I've cc'd Hannah (security) and Marissa (procurement ops) for quick follow-up on controls and PO flow.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF stub)

Appreciate it —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — we filled out the onboarding form and attached it here. Quick answers up front:

- Do we process Redwood customer personal data? Yes — NovusCloud processes telemetry and usage metadata tied to customer accounts to provide analytics and routing. We do not access end-customer PII fields unless configured by the customer.
- Subprocessors: attached novus_subprocessors_20270430.csv (includes AWS, FastLayer CDN, and DataSync Analytics).
- Retention: see notes below; logs/metrics retained 24 months by default; backups retained 7 years; customer-configured exports retained per customer settings.
- DPA: we are happy to execute a DPA. We typically send our standard DPA via DocuSign; if Redwood prefers to use its template we can review redlines.
- SOC 2: we can share a download link to our Type II report once an NDA is on file — happy to provide to Hannah.

Attachments: novus_filled_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF stub), novus_subprocessors_20270430.csv (CSV stub)

Ben (cc'ed) is our technical account lead and will follow up on the security items if needed.

Best,

Hi Olivia — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few follow-ups from security so we can scope the DPA and controls review: 

- Data residency: can you confirm where customer metadata and backups are stored by geographic region (US / EU)? Do you support geo-fencing for EU-only customers?
- Encryption: is customer metadata encrypted at rest and in transit? What KMS provider do you use and do you offer customer-managed keys (CMK/HSM)?
- Retention specifics: you mentioned "logs/metrics retained 24 months" — can you break that out (aggregated metrics vs. request logs). Also confirm retention for audit logs and any administrative access logs.
- SOC 2: please provide the report or a secure download link. If there is an NDA required, we can route a minimal one; alternatively, provide the auditor contact for validation.
- Subprocessors: could you indicate which subprocessors have access to decrypted metadata vs. only encrypted blobs?

Cc'd Marissa for PO/billing details — Marissa, please advise preferred billing contact and any PO number format Novus should reference.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt

Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah / Karthik — thanks for the questions, see answers below and links to the artifacts we can share immediately: 

- Data residency: Primary storage for US customers is us-east-1 (AWS). EU customers can be configured to store data in eu-west-1; we do offer geo-fencing for paid tiers.
- Encryption: All customer metadata is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). We use AWS KMS by default; we support customer-managed keys (CMKs) on enterprise plans and can discuss HSM options if required.
- Retention breakdown: aggregated metrics (no user identifiers) retained 24 months; request-level logs (IP addresses, timestamps) retained 24 months by default but can be shortened on request; backups retained 7 years. Administrative/audit logs retained 3 years.
- SOC 2 Type II: secure download available at https://vault.novuscloud.com/soc2/type2 (access token provided after an NDA). We can also provide a letter from our auditor for procurement review.
- Subprocessors access: AWS (storage/compute) — encrypted storage, Novus employees do not have access to unencrypted backups except via systems with RBAC; DataSync Analytics — limited access to aggregated telemetry only; FastLayer CDN — edge caching only (no PII). Full details in attached novus_subprocessors_20270430.csv.
- DPA: we attached a redwood_vendor_dpa_draft.pdf with our suggested edits. We can execute via DocuSign — link: https://app.pactera.com/docuSign/abc123.
- PO/billing: Please address POs to NovusCloud Inc., Attn: Finance, 212 Market St, Boston, MA 02110. Invoices should be sent to invoices@novuscloud.com. If you provide a PO number we will reference it on the invoice.

Attachments: novus_subprocessors_20270430.csv (CSV stub), redwood_vendor_dpa_draft.pdf (PDF stub)

Let us know if you want to schedule a quick technical call to walk through the encryption/KMS flow. We can also provide the SOC 2 after the minimal procurement NDA is in place.

Regards,
